title: Find the percentage of carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one car
question: Find the percentage of carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one carbon atom and also have at least one triple bond.

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m."XCL_011" = '+' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010" AND a."XCL_003" = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010" AND b."XCL_006" = '#') THEN m."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage FROM molecule m WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM atom a 
            WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010" 
            AND a."XCL_003" = 'c'
        ) 
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM bond b 
            WHERE b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010" 
            AND b."XCL_006" = '#'
        ) 
        THEN m."XCL_010" 
        ELSE NULL 
    END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+'
